title: EE101 Basic Electronics Practical Lab Examination Notice
inputText:
DEPARTMENT OF ELECTRICAL ENGINEERING
Course: EE101 Basic Electrical & Electronics Lab
Notice for 1st Year Undergraduate Batches

Regarding End-Semester Practical Lab Vivas:
The practical exam vivas will tentatively be conducted during the second week of November 2026. Batch-wise room allocation and exact appointment slots will be released later on the notice board.

Students are advised to prepare all lab journals and circuit schematics in advance.

retrievalQueries.query: What is the date for the EE101 lab exam?

notes: Tests model ability to recognize ambiguous/pending dates: must set date=null, additionalInformationPending=true, and needsReview=true. Must not hallucinate an invented day.
